text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Matikanetannhauser and Twin Turbo are doing a joint dance practice, so I head to the park where they're meeting up.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Let's begin! It's Machitan and…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Dance Master Turbo's…

text_block_list.name: Machitan & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heart-pumping, high-speed dance practice!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Teehee. I'm ready, Turbo! But why are we in a park today?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh… Well, there are some veeery deep reasons!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: For starters… there's tons of space to dance! Plus, the sun feels super nice!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right! Okay, so what kind of practice are we doing?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: First, we'll do some crazy wild dance moves! And then we'll get into a crazy wild rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! Crazy, wild dance moves and a crazy, wild rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Machitan & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Tan-tan ta tan-tan… ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm at a loss as to why they need to do this in unison, but I guess it's fine if they're having fun. I watch them silently, until…

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hey! Is that Machitan and Dance Master Turbo? What are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi there. We're practicing our dancing right now.

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: Looks fun! Hey! Can we join in?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Of course! Let's all sing and dance together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Woo, now things are getting exciting! Ooh, ooh! I know! Since we're all here, why don't we bust out a new practice routine?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do it! But what kind?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What do you think we should do, Mr. Trainer Assistant?
choice_data_list: Why not combine dancing with a game?
The best way to learn is by teaching!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What do you think we should do, Ms. Trainer Assistant?
choice_data_list: Why not combine dancing with a game?
The best way to learn is by teaching!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I get it! If you're having fun, you'll learn the dance moves without even thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay, everyone! We're playing dance tag!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's just like regular tag, but you can only move using dance steps! What do you think? Who wants to try?!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: I do! I do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll be "it" to start. Make sure you stay in rhythm when you're running away!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ready? Don't let Machitan catch you, guys!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser and Twin Turbo get in some good dance practice by playing with the children.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I think a name change for our practice is in order!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: It's Machitan and…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Dance Master Turbo's…

text_block_list.name: Machitan & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hyped-up dance class for good kids everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Things start to feel a little like a kids' TV show, but it seems that teaching has helped them get a firmer grip on their own dancing.
